title: Bounds on non-hermite Wigner-Yanase-Dyson skew information
summary: We obtain the relation between non-hermite skew information $NI_{ρ,α}(A)$, $NU_{ρ,α}(A)$, variance $NV_ρ(A)$ and $NJ_{ρ,α}(A)$ by using the maximal eigenvalue and the minimal eigenvalue of density $ρ$. And also we obtain their refinements.
